newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes unchanged vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes unchanged vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The yuan closed unchanged at 8.2979 against the U.S. dollar on Tuesday from Monday's close, consolidating after gains in the past few days, traders said.

The yuan opened up slightly at 8.2978 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market and consolidated in a narrow range of 8.2975 and 8.2980 for most of the session, hitting an intra-day high of 8.2972 and a low of 8.2982.
The yuan consolidated today after breaching the key 8.3000 resistance level last Thursday, but trading remained dull, with most done at 8.2978, traders said.
"The rise of the yuan slowed after gains in the past few days," said one dealer. "The yuan needs to consolidate at the current level before moving up further."
Traders expect the yuan to move between 8.2970 and 8.2980 on Wednesday.
The yuan closed up at 7.2910 from 7.3300 against 100 Japanese yen and unchanged at 1.0740 against the Hong Kong dollar.
